long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Ioannina, George Panagiotis Zoidis entered the drinks trade there with childhood friend Spyros Pappas in 1998. Their Cava 800 business combined a large wine and spirits range with tastings, professional education and wholesale relationships. Zoidis later served as chairman of its operating company, Oktakosia, linking his early regional venture to a continuing corporate role.

In 2013 a new Chalandri venture brought the model to Athens with selected Greek and international wines, spirits, cigars, delicatessen goods and curated gifts. Under Zoidis, the company developed retail and wholesale operations, exclusive import partnerships and further stores in Vouliagmeni and Kifisia. The flagship later broadened into tasting, café and private-dining spaces, combining specialist retail with an expanded hospitality operation.

Kathimerini identifies Ioannina as Zoidis's birthplace, directly supporting Greece as the birth country. No strong source reviewed gives his birth date or year, and the LinkedIn country label does not prove a specific main residence, so those fields remain unproposed.

Multi-brand retail is the narrowest useful active catalogue tag because Oak repeatedly curates many Greek and international product brands and exclusive partnerships. Grocery retail would imply a supermarket model, while Wine production, Beverage manufacturing and Spirits & distilling would incorrectly imply production rather than retail and wholesale.
